# 80 Level

> > 80 Level is a community platform for game developers, digital artists, and CGI/VFX professionals featuring tutorials, industry news, and technical breakdowns.

The site covers game development workflows using Unreal Engine, Unity, Maya, ZBrush, Substance 3D Designer, Substance 3D Painter, and Marmoset Toolbag. It features interviews with industry professionals, game announcements, and in-depth technical articles on 3D modeling, animation systems, and procedural tools.

## Key Topics

- Game Development
- 3D Modeling
- Digital Art
- Unreal Engine
- Unity
- Substance 3D Designer
- Substance 3D Painter
- ZBrush
- Maya
- Marmoset Toolbag
- Tutorials
- Industry News
- Game Announcements
- Technical Breakdowns
- VFX and CGI
